description: This PHP file defines the Total class within the Opencart admin extension controller namespace. It manages listing, installing, and uninstalling total extensions in the Opencart e-commerce platform, including loading language files, permission checks, extension registration, and rendering views.

classes.name: Total
classes.description: Controller class for managing total extensions in the Opencart admin area, including listing, installation, and uninstallation functionalities.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Loads the list of total extensions and outputs the view.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Retrieves available and installed total extensions, loads their language files, and prepares data for the view.

methods.name: install
methods.description: Handles the installation process for a total extension, including permission checks, registration, and calling the extension's install method.

methods.name: uninstall
methods.description: Handles the uninstallation process for a total extension, including permission checks and calling the extension's uninstall method.
